root_cause: Detcore forces container-internal pipe fds physically O_NONBLOCK (nonblockize-and-retry scheduler) while masking the flag from the guest logical view; masking only holds when read/write/fcntl are Detcore-mediated. Under sabre, an execve'd pipeline child has libdetcore_sabre.so loaded but its libc syscall sites are NOT SaBRe-rewritten, so its libc read/write run raw, reach the ptrace fallback (sabre_ptrace.rs), which blanket-trusts all .so mappings (anti-recursion) and runs them natively against the real physically-O_NONBLOCK fd -> EAGAIN never routed through Detcore's retry loop.
fix_status: Not landed. Architectural: correct fix is SaBRe re-instrumenting execve'd children's libc (pinned reverie/SaBRe dep, needs approval + branch + pin bump). Same disposition bucket as reverie#207 RT-signal bug.
